test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 3).
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e94e5efa089154b57a237731eb0d9fcc47e7446bfdd92cbb9b06d73e01a892.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Two type of pattern is followed in this series.

 
• Letters of left hand side are rotation anticlockwise direction and letters of right hand side are rotation clockwise direction. S appears instead of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/922a188673faed8f0fe8604b605d2da85460c940aa1206a9a5b711425268fe0e.png] 

 2. Outer most letters are rotating in clockwise direction and inner most letters are rotating in cyclic order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e862bc85c2018d51a17c790db44a5d02edc4f538c3ff4b088dbaa352cd817c0.png] 

 3. Letters of left hand side are rotation anticlockwise direction and letters of right hand side are rotation clockwise direction. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/980647ce00391b9f5ae1bda8987eb8bbea6eba17284e7d57c12b11371a14f356.png] appears instead of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08606c8630335f9afa3bfc9f3d5631578b232e4d06ce4c2da5433c8a57ddbd74.png] 

 4. Outer most letters are rotating in clockwise direction and inner most letters are rotating in cyclic order.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c60f7d20dd793589bd753d35517bcb1695e78c171414847ec01ac9981656f5b7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
